name: Bereft Hills
subtitle: Wilderness
body: The bereft hill are shunned by locals for a good reason. Strange things wander these parts, the walls of Modbury seem too frail hold the flood of nightmares from the region.

name: Caeraotrom Athenæum
subtitle: Oghma's Blessing
body:
Aratanath Surrkerin, an ancient dragon sage is fabled to have conversed with Oghma. After their last discussion the god missioned him with the construction of the greatest trove of knowledge of the material plane - a place where all could aspire to learn.

There is only one way in and out of the Caeraotrom Athenæum: a small road coming up the mountain from the closest town. There is 150 km separating the two, with a 600m elevation gain.

name: The Alabaster Palace
subtitle: King's Estate
summary: Eperina's seat of power, on the cliff of Brightend.
body: The seat of power in Brightend. From here, the King oversees the distribution of resources across the vale.

name: Warden Fort
subtitle: Headquarters and barracks
body: The epicenter of law enforcement and military power in Brightend. The elite military corp is respected through the whole country.

name: Oddmoss Librarium
subtitle: Ancient tomes and dusty books
body: One of the finest bookshops in the region, known by scholars for their dedication to procuring old and rare volumes.

name: Brawn & Brawn Agency
subtitle: Nimo and Gust's mercenary agency
body: A small office tucked neatly between two impressive homes in the Cloud District houses the yound mercenary agency. Already hired by the Crown, the agency sees itself becoming a staple of the city.

name: Gilded Goldfinch
subtitle: The finest drinks and eats the city has to offer
body: The finest inn in the city... or the country, according to owner Merton Lensher.

signature.name: Goldfinch Reserve
signature.desc: Amber mead aged in the cellar; Merton pours it himself.

signature.name: The Lensher Roast
signature.desc: Whatever Merton deems worthy today. Ask.

name: Thayne Household
subtitle: Where the traumatized widower lives.
body: We all know what happened here... it's like zombies were done to the cupboard

name: Finest Cloth
subtitle: Where the best fabric is!
body: Late Elira Thayne's tailor shop. Only the best materials, coming from all over the continent, assembled by the best seamstresses!

name: Turris Magi Finisclari
subtitle: The Archamge's Tower
body: The Turris Magi is the second highest building in the cloud district, second the Alabaster Palace. It is a landmark known by all but feared by most. As a place of magic most people shun it and some even avoid it.

name: The Fighting Pits
subtitle: Danger Zone
body: Underground arenas where disputes are settled in blood and illegal wagers are the city's true currency.

name: Harbour Master
body: Where the master habours... or something

name: Oxana's Gems
subtitle: Jewelry Emporium
body: Oxana's Gem stands tall and proud as the oldest jeweler in Brightend. This 4th generation shop is famous through out the city, and even further...

name: Black Rose Inn
subtitle: Fresh Water, Warm Beds, Decent Wine... sometimes
body: The coolest and edgiest inn in town.

tavern.hours: Dawn to midnight; later if the wine holds out

signature.name: Deercrest Venison Stew
signature.desc: The town's pride, simmered since morning.

name: The Stoat and Cellar
subtitle: Poor, but cozy
body: A cozy tavern, if a poor one, in the scrap-built town of Silverbrook. It is owned by Rowan Larkspur, a tattooed halfling.

signature.name: House Mull
signature.desc: A hot mulled drink, and the only reason to brave winter here.
